versions.changelog: V2 remediation: added Clean Scan Evidence and Install-First Success Path to ACCEPTANCE.md (post-publish debt, no functional changes)

Initial release of migraine-trigger-pattern-log skill.

- Provides a clinician-friendly migraine/headache log template including episode timelines, context factors, symptom notes, medication response tracking, red-flag guidance, and a concise appointment summary.
- Emphasizes observation and pattern tracking rather than diagnosis or self-treatment.
- Includes workflow to support personal tracking, appointment prep, and clear communication with healthcare providers.
- Offers safety boundaries: does not diagnose or recommend treatment changes; directs users to seek urgent care for red-flag symptoms.
- Output includes a structured pattern snapshot, episode log, context checklist, pattern review, summary for clinicians, weekly review prompt, and open questions.
